explanation: qc-b and qc-c are the two rows that legitimately match Firestore documents. On the export path their prior row IS that document, so they inherit its real creation timestamp; a rebuild has no access to it and keeps the 2026-08-12 default the bundle was seeded with. This is Firestore truth arriving for the first time, not an identity defect, and it is confined to a non-identity field on two rows. Production was published through SKIP_EXPORT, which is why the deployed bundle carries the default.
